articles.summary: Why is fusion plasma pink? Learn what plasma is and how hydrogen fuel creates the distinctive fuchsia color seen in Helion's fusion machines.
articles.title: Why is fusion plasma pink?

articles.summary: Fusion is the process that powers the sun, combining light atoms to release vast amounts of clean energy. Learn how fusion works, why it’s challenging to achieve on Earth, and how it could provide abundant, carbon-free electricity for the future.
articles.title: What is fusion?
